graphhopper.config:
graphhopper:
  datareader.file: /work/region.osm.pbf
  graph.location: /work/graphhopper/graph
  graph.encoded_values: car_access,car_average_speed,road_access,bike_access,bike_average_speed,bike_priority,bike_road_access,foot_access,foot_average_speed,foot_priority,foot_road_access,road_class,road_environment,roundabout,surface,smoothness,hike_rating,mtb_rating,country
  profiles:
    - name: car
      custom_model_files: [car.json]
      turn_costs:
        vehicle_types: [motorcar, motor_vehicle]
    - name: bike
      custom_model_files: [bike.json]
    - name: foot
      custom_model_files: [foot.json]
  profiles_ch:
    - profile: car
    - profile: bike
    - profile: foot
  profiles_lm: []
  import.osm.ignored_highways: construction
  prepare.ch.threads: 1
server:
  application_connectors:
    - type: http
      port: 8989
      bind_host: 0.0.0.0
  admin_connectors: []
logging:
  level: INFO
